findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "crypto-governance" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: crypto-governance_governance-execution-diff, crypto-governance_execution-risk-score · Private data: crypto-governance_execution-risk-score · Public sink: crypto-governance_governance-execution-diff, crypto-governance_execution-risk-score · Destructive: crypto-governance_governance-execution-diff, crypto-governance_execution-risk-score.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: crypto-governance_governance-execution-diff, crypto-governance_execution-risk-score · Private data: crypto-governance_execution-risk-score · Public sink: crypto-governance_governance-execution-diff, crypto-governance_execution-risk-score · Destructive: crypto-governance_governance-execution-diff, crypto-governance_execution-risk-score

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
